blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The International Criminal Court (ICC) Trial Chamber III has ruled to keep former President Rodrigo Duterte detained, citing an increased flight risk amid recent developments regarding his case. In a five-page decision issued after the tribunal’s third status conference, the chamber pointed to several recent developments as grounds for its ruling: the trial’s scheduled start on Nov. 30, 2026; court-appointed medical experts’ reports on Duterte’s fitness to stand trial; and the prosecution’s disclosure of evidence and submission of its trial brief. According to the chamber, it is these developments that had increased the prospect of Duterte facing trial […]... Keep on reading: Duterte to remain detained – ICC
